title: Bowling Game with Undo/Redo
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with a 3D bowling game using Three.js that features undo/redo functionality. Load the 'horse.glb' model using GLTFLoader from a CDN (use https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js) and place it as a decorative mascot beside the bowling lane.

SCENE SETUP:
- Camera: Perspective camera at position (0, 8, 15) looking down the lane toward the pins.
- Lights: One ambient light (intensity 0.5) and one directional light at (5, 10, 5) with intensity 1.0.
- A bowling lane: A long box (2 units wide, 0.2 units tall, 20 units long) colored #C4A46C (wood color), centered at (0, 0, -5).
- Gutters: Two dark gray boxes on each side of the lane, slightly lower.
- 10 bowling pins: White cylinders (radius 0.15, height 0.6) arranged in standard triangle formation at z = -14. Rows at z=-14, z=-14.5, z=-15, z=-15.5 with 1,2,3,4 pins respectively, spaced 0.5 apart.
- Bowling ball: A sphere (radius 0.3) colored #222244 at starting position (0, 0.5, 5).
- Load 'horse.glb' and place it at position (3, 0, 0) scaled to (0.5, 0.5, 0.5) as a lane mascot.

PHYSICS (simplified):
- When the player launches the ball, it travels forward (negative z) at speed 0.3 per frame.
- Collision detection: When the ball is within 0.5 units of any standing pin, that pin is knocked down (rotate it 90 degrees on x-axis and change its y position to 0.15).
- The ball stops when it reaches z = -16 or goes out of lane bounds (|x| > 1.2).
- Track which pins were knocked down each throw.

USER INTERACTIONS:
- LEFT/RIGHT arrow keys: Move the ball left/right along x-axis (clamped to -0.8 to 0.8) before launching.
- SPACEBAR: Launch the ball forward. Disabled if ball is already moving or game is over.
- 'U' key: Undo the last throw — restore all pins knocked in the last throw to standing, reset ball to its pre-throw position.
- 'R' key: Redo the undone throw — re-knock the same pins, move ball to post-throw position.
- A 'Reset Game' button (DOM) to fully reset all state.

STATE MANAGEMENT (window.__3D_STATE__):
- ballPosition: {x, y, z} current ball position
- ballMoving: boolean, true while ball is in motion
- pinsStanding: number (0-10), count of pins currently standing
- pinsKnockedThisThrow: number, pins knocked in the most recent completed throw
- throwCount: number, total throws taken (not counting undone throws)
- undoAvailable: boolean, true if there is a throw to undo
- redoAvailable: boolean, true if there is an undone throw to redo
- score: number, total pins knocked down across all throws
- horseLoaded: boolean, true once horse.glb is loaded
- gameOver: boolean, true when all pins are down or max 3 throws reached

HUD/UI:
- Top-left: Display 'Score: X' and 'Throws: Y/3' in white text with dark background.
- Top-right: Display 'Undo (U)' and 'Redo (R)' status indicators — green if available, gray if not.
- Bottom-center: 'Reset Game' button styled with padding and rounded corners.
- Show instructions text: 'Arrow keys to aim, Space to throw, U to undo, R to redo'

HISTORY SYSTEM:
- Maintain a history stack of throw states. Each entry stores: ball start position, which specific pins were knocked, and score before the throw.
- Undo pops from history, restores pins and score. Redo re-applies.
- After a new throw, clear the redo stack.
- Maximum 3 throws per game.
physics_constraints: Ball travels at constant speed along -z axis. Pin collision at distance < 0.5 units. Ball x-position clamped to [-0.8, 0.8]. Ball stops at z <= -16. Pins knocked down rotate 90° on x-axis. Undo restores exact pin states. Redo re-applies exact pin knockdowns.
